country_event = { # Path Selector Depending on Pre-Election Tree
	id = IBR_campaign.0
	immediate = {
		log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: event IBR_campaign.0"
		set_country_flag = IBR_Elections_Happening
		clr_country_flag = IBR_caudillo_mechanic_started
		set_country_flag = IBR_caudillo_mechanic_over
	}
	title = IBR_campaign.0.t
	desc = IBR_campaign.0.d
	picture = GFX_report_event_IBR_congress_clapping
	is_triggered_only = yes
	fire_only_once = yes
	hidden = yes

	option = { #Proceed, give faction choice event if needed
		name = IBR_campaign.0.a
		ai_chance = { factor = 10 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					OR = {
						has_country_flag = IBR_election_play_rc
						has_country_flag = IBR_election_play_cc
					}
				}
			}
			country_event = { id = IBR_campaign.1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = IBR_election_play_cc
			}
			country_event = { id = IBR_campaign.10 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = IBR_election_play_rc
			}
			country_event = { id = IBR_campaign.30 }
		}
	}
}

	immediate = { log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: event IBR_barcelona.1" }

	desc = IBR_barcelona.1.d
	picture = GFX_report_event_generic_crate_of_guns

	is_triggered_only = yes
	fire_only_once = yes

	immediate = { #Path selector
		hidden_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_leader = { character = IBR_Francisco_Franco ruling_only = yes } }
				set_country_flag = IBR_barcelona_franco_path
			}
			else = {
				set_country_flag = IBR_barcelona_salazar_path
			}
		}
	}

	option = { #Investigate
		name = IBR_barcelona.1.a
		ai_chance = { factor = 10 }
		set_country_flag = IBR_barcelona_started
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = IBR_barcelona_franco_path }
			hidden_effect = {
				country_event = {
					id = IBR_barcelona.3
					days = 3
				}
			}
			custom_effect_tooltip = IBR_barcelona_franco_tt
		}
		else = {
			hidden_effect = {
				country_event = {
					id = IBR_barcelona.2
					days = 3
				}
			}
			custom_effect_tooltip = IBR_barcelona_salazar_tt
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					has_country_flag = IBR_advisory_council_created_flag
					has_country_flag = IBR_legislative_council_created_flag
				}
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				country_event = {
					id = IBR_council_creation.20
					days = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

country_event = { #GRAND INFLUENCE TICKER
	id = IBR_terror.505
	immediate = { log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: event IBR_terror.505" }
	title = IBR_terror.505.t
	desc = IBR_terror.505.d
	picture = GFX_report_event_IBR_road_work_2

	is_triggered_only = yes
	fire_only_once = no

	trigger = {
		NOT = {
			AND = {
				has_country_flag = IBR_CNT_Broken
				has_country_flag = IBR_BTA_Broken
				has_country_flag = IBR_ETA_Broken
				has_country_flag = IBR_FSLP_Broken
			}
		}
	}
	hidden = yes
	immediate = {
		hidden_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { is_ai = no }
				IBR_assign_current_goverment_terrorism_multiplier = yes
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = { has_country_flag = IBR_CNT_Broken }
					}
					IBR_CNT_ticker = yes
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = { has_country_flag = IBR_BTA_Broken }
					}
					IBR_BTA_ticker = yes
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = { has_country_flag = IBR_ETA_Broken }
					}
					IBR_ETA_ticker = yes
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = { has_country_flag = IBR_FSLP_Broken }
					}
					IBR_FSLP_ticker = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = IBR_terror.505.a
		ai_chance = { factor = 10 }
		set_temp_variable = { activity_temp_variable = 0 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { activity_temp_variable = IBR_CNT_Activity }
		add_to_temp_variable = { activity_temp_variable = IBR_ETA_Activity }
		add_to_temp_variable = { activity_temp_variable = IBR_BTA_Activity }
		add_to_temp_variable = { activity_temp_variable = IBR_FSLP_Activity }

		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { activity_temp_variable < 10 }
			}
			random = {
				chance = 20
				ZZZ = {
					country_event = {
						id = IBR_terror.500
						hours = 1
					}
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { activity_temp_variable < 20 }
			}
			random = {
				chance = 40
				ZZZ = {
					country_event = {
						id = IBR_terror.500
						hours = 1
					}
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { activity_temp_variable < 30 }
			}
			random = {
				chance = 60
				ZZZ = {
					country_event = {
						id = IBR_terror.500
						hours = 1
					}
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			random = {
				chance = 80
				ZZZ = {
					country_event = {
						id = IBR_terror.500
						hours = 1
					}
				}
			}
		}

		country_event = {
			id = IBR_terror.505
			days = 27
		}
		IBR_terror_vulnerable_check = yes
		IBR_AAS_resources_ticker = yes
	}
}

country_event = { # FLASHPOINT (SALAZAR DEATH) - The Link That Breaks the Chain
	id = IBR_post_salazar.1
	immediate = { log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: event IBR_post_salazar.1" }
	title = IBR_post_salazar.1.t
	desc = IBR_post_salazar.1.d
	picture = GFX_report_event_IBR_salazar_sad_desk
	is_triggered_only = yes
	fire_only_once = yes
	trigger = {
		NOT = {
			has_country_flag = IBR_Iberian_Wars_have_happened
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = IBR_post_salazar.1.a
		ai_chance = { factor = 10 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = IBR_advisory_council_created_flag
				has_country_flag = cau_strong_salazar
			}
			add_political_power = -200
			set_temp_variable = { IBR_stability_temp = -15 }
			IBR_stability_change = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					AND = {
						has_country_flag = IBR_advisory_council_created_flag
						has_country_flag = cau_weak_salazar
					}
					AND = {
						has_country_flag = IBR_legislative_council_created_flag
						has_country_flag = cau_strong_salazar
					}
				}
			}
			add_political_power = -175
			set_temp_variable = { IBR_stability_temp = -12 }
			IBR_stability_change = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				AND = {
					has_country_flag = IBR_legislative_council_created_flag
					has_country_flag = cau_weak_salazar
				}
			}
			add_political_power = -150
			set_temp_variable = { IBR_stability_temp = -10 }
			IBR_stability_change = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = IBR_advisory_council_created_flag
			}
			add_political_power = -125
			set_temp_variable = { IBR_stability_temp = -9 }
			IBR_stability_change = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = IBR_legislative_council_created_flag
			}
			add_political_power = -100
			set_temp_variable = { IBR_stability_temp = -7 }
			IBR_stability_change = yes
		}
		retire_character = IBR_Antonio_Salazar
		set_country_flag = IBR_Salazar_dead
		set_country_flag = IBR_Salazar_transition

		clr_country_flag = IBR_decisions_stability
		hidden_effect = {
			every_country = {
				limit = {
					is_ai = no
					HasIberiaInterest = yes
				}
				news_event = {
					id = WORLD.468
					days = 1
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					AND = {
						country_exists = SLG
						SLG = { is_subject_of = IBR }
					}
				}
				country_event = {
					id = IBR_algeria.15
					days = 1
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = IBR_dissolving_the_union }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_game_rule = {
						rule = IBR_STABILITY_ROUTE
						option = IBR_STABILITY_ROUTE_COLLAPSE_SALAZAR
					}
				}
				set_variable = { IBRIberiaStability = 0 }
				IBR_stability_update = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					has_game_rule = {
						rule = IBR_STABILITY_ROUTE
						option = IBR_STABILITY_ROUTE_DIVORCE
					}
				}
				set_variable = { IBRIberiaStability = 33 }
				IBR_stability_update = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					has_game_rule = {
						rule = IBR_STABILITY_ROUTE
						option = IBR_STABILITY_ROUTE_STABLE
					}
				}
				set_variable = { IBRIberiaStability = 50 }
				IBR_stability_update = yes
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { IBRIberiaStability < 21 }
				}
				hidden_effect = {
					country_event = {
						id = IBR_post_salazar.999
						days = 3
					}
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { IBRIberiaStability < 36 }
				}
				custom_effect_tooltip = IBR_divorce_decision_tt
				set_country_flag = { flag = IBR_divorce_decision_flag value = 1 days = 15 }
				if = {
					limit = {
						IBR = {
							is_ai = yes
						}
					}
					country_event = {
						id = IBR_divorce.0
					}
				}
			}
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			IBR = {
				IBR_Francisco_Franco = {
					promote_character = despotism_civilian_dictatorship_subtype
					promote_character = fascism_2_subtype
					promote_character = fascism_subtype
					promote_character = despotism_3_subtype
					promote_character = despotism_2_subtype
					promote_character = paternalism_subtype
					promote_character = paternalism_1_subtype
					remove_advisor_role = { slot = head_of_government }
					add_advisor_role = {
						advisor = {
							slot = head_of_government
							idea_token = IBR_Francisco_Franco_Post_Salazar_hog
							traits = {
								head_of_government
								advisor_franco_trait
							}
							ledger = civilian
							cost = -1
						}
					}
				}
				set_country_leader_description = { desc = "POLITICS_FRANCISCO_FRANCO_POST_SALAZAR_DESC" }
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_leader_with_trait = weak_franco_trait
					}
					remove_country_leader_trait = weak_franco_trait
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_leader_with_trait = strong_franco_trait
					}
					remove_country_leader_trait = strong_franco_trait
				}
				remove_ideas_with_trait = head_of_government
				add_ideas = IBR_Generic_Vacant_hog
			}

			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = IBR_dissolving_the_union }
				}
				load_focus_tree = {
					tree = IBR_death_of_salazar
					keep_completed = yes
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = cau_strong_franco }
				set_country_flag = death_strong_franco
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = cau_weak_franco }
				set_country_flag = death_weak_franco
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = cau_weak_salazar }
				set_country_flag = death_weak_salazar
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = cau_strong_salazar }
				set_country_flag = death_strong_salazar
			}
		}
	}
}

	title = IBR_council_fate.1.t
	desc = IBR_council_fate.1.d
	picture = GFX_report_event_IBR_cortes_building
	is_triggered_only = yes
	fire_only_once = no
	trigger = {
		tag = IBR
		NOT = {
			has_country_flag = IBR_dissolving_the_union
			has_country_flag = IBR_Iberian_Wars_have_happened
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = IBR_council_fate.1.a
		ai_chance = { factor = 10 }
		load_focus_tree = {
			tree = IBR_the_iberian_congress
			keep_completed = yes
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			complete_national_focus = IBR_the_state_of_the_union
			remove_ideas = IBR_Luis_Camara_Pina_army_chief
			remove_ideas = IBR_Joao_Corte_Real_air_chief
			add_ideas = IBR_Alberto_Andrade_Silva_army_chief
			add_ideas = IBR_Luis_Navarro_Garnica_air_chief
			country_event = {
				id = IBR_inspector.7
				days = 20
			}
			country_event = {
				id = IBR_council_fate.3
				days = 5
			}
		}
	}
}

					days = 1
				}
			}
			else = {

					id = IBR_natcon.41
					days = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

	immediate = { log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: event IBRCouncilAmendment.14" }
	title = IBRCouncilAmendment.14.t
	desc = IBRCouncilAmendment.14.desc
	immediate = {
		set_temp_variable = { IBR_amendment_temp = token:IBR_law_counter_insurgency_am_m_2 }
		set_temp_variable = { IBR_amendment_slot_temp = 1 }
		IBR_council_add_amendment = yes
	}
	is_triggered_only = yes
	picture = GFX_report_event_IBR_intellectuals_sitting
	option = {
		name = IBRCouncilAmendment.14.a
		set_temp_variable = { IBR_amendment_slot_temp = 1 }
		IBR_council_accept_amendment = yes
		set_country_flag = IBR_council_moderate_amendment_2_flag
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = IBR_council_moderate_amendment_1_flag
			}
			set_temp_variable = { IBR_council_temp_influence = 1.5 }
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { IBR_council_temp_influence = 2.5 }
		}
		custom_effect_tooltip = IBR_council_advisory_moderate_amendment_tt
		IBR_council_advance_bill_to_vote = yes
	}
	option = {
		name = IBRCouncilAmendment.14.b
		set_temp_variable = { IBR_amendment_slot_temp = 1 }
		IBR_council_reject_amendment = yes
		IBR_council_advance_bill_to_vote = yes
	}
}

	immediate = { log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: event IBRCouncilAmendment.103" }
	title = IBRCouncilAmendment.103.t
	desc = IBRCouncilAmendment.103.desc
	immediate = {
		set_temp_variable = { IBR_amendment_temp = token:IBR_law_tariff_expansion_am_i_1 }
		set_temp_variable = { IBR_amendment_slot_temp = 0 }
		IBR_council_add_amendment = yes
	}
	is_triggered_only = yes
	picture = GFX_report_event_ENG_Workers_In_Factory
	option = {
		name = IBRCouncilAmendment.103.a
		set_temp_variable = { IBR_amendment_slot_temp = 0 }
		IBR_council_accept_amendment = yes
		set_country_flag = IBR_council_independent_amendment_1_flag
		set_temp_variable = { IBR_council_temp_influence = 2.5 }
		custom_effect_tooltip = IBR_council_advisory_independent_amendment_tt
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = IBR_advisory_council_political_tie_flag
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				random_list = {
					33 = {
						country_event = {
							id = IBRCouncilAmendment.100
							days = 5
						}
					}
					33 = {
						country_event = {
							id = IBRCouncilAmendment.102
							days = 5
						}
					}
					33 = {
						country_event = {
							id = IBRCouncilAmendment.104
							days = 5
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			hidden_effect = {
				country_event = {
					id = IBRCouncilAmendment.104
					days = 5
				}
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = IBRCouncilAmendment.103.b
		set_temp_variable = { IBR_amendment_slot_temp = 0 }
		IBR_council_reject_amendment = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = IBR_advisory_council_political_tie_flag
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				random_list = {
					33 = {
						country_event = {
							id = IBRCouncilAmendment.100
							days = 5
						}
					}
					33 = {
						country_event = {
							id = IBRCouncilAmendment.102

					}
					33 = {

country_event = { #Passed with good majority (>250 seats)
	id = IBR_council_law.1
	immediate = { log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: event IBR_council_law.1" }
	title = IBR_council_law.1.t
	desc = IBR_council_law.1.d
	picture = GFX_report_event_IBR_advisory_council_meeting
	is_triggered_only = yes
	fire_only_once = no
	option = {
		name = IBR_council_law.1.a
		ai_chance = { factor = 10 }
		IBR_council_pass_law = yes
		#Effects of reformism
		set_temp_variable = { Iberian_Council_reformism_var_temp = IBR_council_active_law_reformism }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { Iberian_Council_reformism_var_temp = 50 }
		divide_temp_variable = { Iberian_Council_reformism_var_temp = 10 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = {
					var = IBR_council_active_law_reformism
					value = 50
					compare = greater_than_or_equals
				}
			}
			set_temp_variable = { Iberian_Council_multiplier = 100 }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { Iberian_Council_multiplier = Iberian_Council_reformism_var }
			divide_temp_variable = { Iberian_Council_multiplier = 100 }
			add_to_temp_variable = { Iberian_Council_multiplier = 1 }
			multiply_temp_variable = { Iberian_Council_reformism_var_temp = Iberian_Council_multiplier }
		}
		IBR_change_council_reformism = yes
		#Effects of number of seats that support the law
		set_temp_variable = { pp_reward = IBR_council_total_supporting_seats }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { pp_reward = 250 }
		divide_temp_variable = { pp_reward = 2 }
		add_political_power = pp_reward
		#Reset variables
		clr_country_flag = IBR_council_active_law_flag
		clr_country_flag = IBR_council_investment_bill
		set_variable = { IBR_council_active_law_var = 0 }
		set_variable = { IBR_council_active_law_amendments^0 = 0 }
		set_variable = { IBR_council_active_law_amendments^1 = 0 }
		set_variable = { IBR_council_active_law_amendments^2 = 0 }
		set_variable = { IBR_council_active_law_amendments^3 = 0 }
		set_variable = { IBR_council_active_law_amendments^4 = 0 }
		set_variable = { IBR_council_active_law_amendments_state^0 = 0 }
		set_variable = { IBR_council_active_law_amendments_state^1 = 0 }

		set_variable = { IBR_council_active_law_amendments_state^3 = 0 }
		set_variable = { IBR_council_active_law_amendments_state^4 = 0 }
		set_variable = { IBR_council_accepted_investments = 0 }
		set_variable = { IBR_council_total_supporting_seats = 0 }
		set_variable = { IBR_council_total_abstain_seats = 0 }
		set_variable = { IBR_council_total_against_seats = 0 }
		IBR_rerender_democratic_council_regular = yes
	}
}

country_event = { #Passed by simple majority
	id = IBR_council_law.6
	immediate = { log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: event IBR_council_law.6" }
	title = IBR_council_law.6.t
	desc = IBR_council_law.6.d
	picture = GFX_report_event_IBR_advisory_council_meeting
	is_triggered_only = yes
	fire_only_once = no
	option = {
		name = IBR_council_law.6.a
		ai_chance = { factor = 10 }
		IBR_council_pass_law = yes
		# Progressivism Effect
		set_temp_variable = { IBR_government_progressivism_temp = IBR_council_active_law_reformism }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { IBR_ideology_temp = 50 }
		divide_temp_variable = { IBR_government_progressivism_temp = 10 }
		IBR_change_council_progressivism = yes
		# Ideology Effect
		set_temp_variable = { IBR_ideology_temp = IBR_council_active_law_reformism }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { IBR_ideology_temp = 50 }
		multiply_temp_variable = { IBR_ideology_temp = -1 }
		divide_temp_variable = { IBR_ideology_temp = 25 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = IBRCentrist70Victory
			}
			set_temp_variable = { IBR_CD_ideology_temp = IBR_ideology_temp }
			IBR_democratic_council_change_CD_ideology = yes
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { IBR_AP_ideology_temp = IBR_ideology_temp }
			IBR_democratic_council_change_AP_ideology = yes
		}
		#Reset variables
		clr_country_flag = IBR_council_active_law_flag
		set_variable = { IBR_council_active_law_var = 0 }
		set_variable = { IBR_council_active_law_amendments^0 = 0 }
		set_variable = { IBR_council_active_law_amendments^1 = 0 }
		set_variable = { IBR_council_active_law_amendments^2 = 0 }

		set_variable = { IBR_council_active_law_amendments_state^0 = 0 }
		set_variable = { IBR_council_active_law_amendments_state^1 = 0 }
		set_variable = { IBR_council_active_law_amendments_state^2 = 0 }
		set_variable = { IBR_council_active_law_amendments_state^3 = 0 }
		set_variable = { IBR_council_active_law_amendments_state^4 = 0 }
		set_variable = { IBR_council_accepted_investments = 0 }
		set_variable = { IBR_council_total_supporting_seats = 0 }
		set_variable = { IBR_council_total_abstain_seats = 0 }
		set_variable = { IBR_council_total_against_seats = 0 }
